findings.claim: 有節目簡介稱 WDC 製造足跡高度集中於泰國與馬來西亞，並受新「原產地」解釋審視（二手來源，未對照 10-K）
findings.source: Audible 2026Q2 Western Digital Corporation (WDC) 節目簡介
findings.excerpt: Western Digital's manufacturing footprint, heavily concentrated in Thailand and Malaysia, faces scrutiny under new "Country of Origin" interpretations

findings.claim: 磁頭獨立供應商僅 TDK 一家，同時供應三大 HDD 廠（引 Bloomberg，經供應商部落格轉述）
findings.source: Fusion Worldwide blog: How China's export controls are disrupting HDD manufacturing and supply
findings.excerpt: TDK is the only independent supplier of magnetic recording heads and currently supplies all three HDD giants.

findings.claim: 中國稀土出口管制：中重稀土出貨仍需逐案核准，暫停期至 2026-11-10（供應商部落格轉述）
findings.source: Fusion Worldwide blog: Is Hard Disk Drive Supply the Next Major Infrastructure Bottleneck?

findings.claim: WDC 10-Q 稱關稅行動截至 2026 會計年度第一季未對經營造成重大影響，持續監控
findings.excerpt: Our business and results of operations have not been materially impacted through the first quarter of 2026 as a result of the recent tariff actions, but we are actively monitoring developments.

findings.claim: 法說會答覆稱已開發稀土與貴金屬替代供應來源，預期出口管制無重大影響（逐字稿日期未顯示）
findings.excerpt: developed alternate sources of supply for rare earth and precious minerals, so we do not anticipate any material impact from export controls

note: as_of 多為估計值：搜尋摘要未顯示確切發布日（Audible、Fusion、法說會答覆皆僅知約略期間）；稀土 finding 無逐字 excerpt。缺 WDC 10-K 對泰/馬產能占比的一手數字。
